title: a file laid out another way outside hooks gets jitso's hooks member and nothing else changes, and --remove gives the bytes back
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, v0.1.2 fixes (J21): setup hook edits only the root member hooks
intent: INTENDED behavior (J21, supersedes the layout half of N-17). prettier formats `.claude/settings.json` in the boilerplates (inline arrays, `"ask": []`), and the whole-file layout rule refused every such file. The edit now touches only the root member `hooks`: when it is absent, a comma goes after the last root member and `\n  "hooks": <value>` after that, before the closing brace; every other byte stays as written (keys on one line, an indent that jumps, a `\u` escape, extra blank lines at the end, a space before a colon, prettier's inline arrays). Each row's seed is `{{head}}{{tail}}`: `head` ends with the last root member, so the expected file is `head`, the comma, jitso's member, `tail`. A second run is `nothing to do`, and `--remove` gives the seed back byte for byte.

stdout: nothing to do (the guard is already registered in .claude/settings.json)
